LESSON: KUSOMA 7.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA MATINI YA KUJICHAGULIA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: ELIMU YA MAZINGIRA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Mapendekezo ya 
Topic 7.2: Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba
2. kusoma matini ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha inayotumiwa

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kusoma matini ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha inayotumiwa
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma matini ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha inayotumiwa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
4. Show that you can: kutambua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba
2. kusoma matini ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha inayotumiwa

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
